shots.title: 建立环境
shots.prompt: A cinematic wide establishing shot of a spring flower meadow under soft morning sunlight. Two original animated cats appear far apart among white daisies. A calm breeze stirs the flowers and the soft grass while the camera slowly moves forward at eye level. No subtitles, no letters, no logos. Gentle birdsong and soft outdoor ambience.

shots.title: 猫咪靠近
shots.prompt: In the same peaceful meadow, a black and white animated cat gently walks along a narrow path between flowers. A fluffy brown cat approaches from the other side, keeping a natural walking pace. The camera tracks them smoothly from a medium distance. The meadow, morning light, and colors match the previous shot. Gentle wind and paws on grass, no on-screen text.

shots.title: 温暖结尾
shots.prompt: A warm close shot of the two animated cats sitting side by side in a meadow of bright daisies. The camera makes a restrained slow arc, keeping the cats centered. Their expressions remain natural, with subtle ear motion and a calm peaceful atmosphere. A few petals move in the wind. Soft outdoor ambience without dialogue. No subtitles and no text.
